name: Zhejiang Tony Electronic Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Tony Electronic Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of alloy wires and metal matrix composite materials worldwide. The company offers consumer electronics, including magnetic materials, conductors, enameled wires, and copper coils; new energy vehicles, such as FPC and CCS products, and tab lead and AI-plastic films; and medical cables and cable harnesses. It also provides solar photovoltaic products, including diamond cutting wires and solar films. In addition, the company offers semiconductor materials consisting SiC products. Tony Electronic Co., Ltd was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Huzhou, China.
